links.note: the deep dasya bhakti of the second pad -> she would be blessed even by doing his chakari; 25054 is the chakar-rakho plea
which examples she gives while pleading for her pain to be removed -- the omnibus plea, whose unifying concept is the dainya bhaav of 25048
the names she gives her lord -> Girdhar, Gopal, Nandlal, Hari; 25047 is the concept that names Girdhar Gopal as her aaradhya
kavya-saundarya of 'Dropadi ri laaj rakhi, aap badhayo cheer' -- the leading couplet is the Draupadi rescue, 25051
kavya-saundarya of 'chakar rahsyun baag lagasyun nit uth darsan paasyun' -- that couplet is 25055
kavya-saundarya of 'mor mukut peetambar sohai ... Bindrawan mein dhenu charave' -- the Vrindavan cowherd form of the deity in 25047; no concept describes the form separately
what the kunjar peer was and how it ended -> the crocodile was killed; 25059 exactly
whom she calls Girdhar and why -> Krishna who lifted Govardhan; 25047 names Girdhar Gopal
bhaav of 'Hari aap haro jan ri bheer ...' -> she prays for her own and all people's pain; the dainya pleading of 25048
why she wants his chakari and not worldly comfort -- 25054, the chakar-rakho plea
the arguments she offers to obtain darshan -> garden, singing in Vrindavan, the kusumbi sari; the darshan-winning apparatus of 25055
the pratipadya of her pads -> single-minded love, coaxing and reproaching her lord; 25048 is the dainya-and-madhurya concept
her lok-kalyaan feeling in the first pad -> she prays for ordinary people's pain too; the dainya bhaav of 25048
